0022600006.text: The 76ers come into this home game at 1-0 after a road win, sitting 1st in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East, while the Cavaliers have yet to play a 2026-27 game. Cleveland swept Philadelphia 4-0 in the 2025-26 season, and the most recent meeting was a 115-101 Cavaliers win in Cleveland on March 9, 2026. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (out, back), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps), and Dean Wade is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. Cleveland is without Khalifa Diop (out, knee) and Nae'Qwan Tomlin (out, back), and Jarrett Allen is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision.
